_note: RH Terminal defaults. Gates and flags are starting values, not results of a backtest like the DLMM spec: change them in ⚙ Settings (saved in data/settings.json) as you learn what works.

universe._maxLpFeePct: above this a pool is a honeypot rather than a fee tier (RH Pool: nothing real exists between 20% and 60%)

scan._maxPools: pools (by last hour's fees) that get DexScreener data; watchlist and open positions always do

gates._minFeePctDay: best of the 1h pace and the 24h figure, fees / TVL per day

flags._nightEntryLocalHours: DLMM found night entries worse on Solana; no RH data yet. [0, 9] turns the flag on (WIB)

position._ladder: RH ladder (same as RH Pool): equal-width slices from rangeTopPct down to rangeBottomPct below the price, quote-only, weights 1:2:...:n (deepest slice biggest)

ping._sortBy: fee1hPct (fees last hour / TVL) | fees1hUsd | volTvl1h | fee24hPct
